description: This file defines the AutoPurgeScheduler class responsible for scheduling and executing automatic task purging operations within a VSCode extension environment. It manages periodic purge checks, manual triggers, and interacts with services for telemetry and purging logic.

classes.name: AutoPurgeScheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling and execution of automatic purge operations, including starting, stopping, manual triggers, and status reporting.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler and sets up the first purge check after a startup delay.

methods.name: triggerManualPurge
methods.description: Manually triggers a purge operation outside the scheduled intervals.

methods.name: runScheduledPurge
methods.description: Performs the scheduled purge check, respecting settings and timing constraints.

methods.name: executePurge
methods.description: Executes the actual purge process, including telemetry and user notifications.

methods.name: scheduleNext
methods.description: Schedules the next automatic purge check.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the scheduler, including whether it is running and when the next run is scheduled.
